title: Habakkuk Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Habakkuk 2: the vision written on tablets, the woes against the plunderer, and Yahweh in his holy temple.

questions.text: Where does the speaker say he will stand to watch?
questions.explanation: Habakkuk 2:1 says he will stand at his watch and set himself on the ramparts to see what will be said to him.

answers.text: At his watch, on the ramparts
At the gate of the city
In the court of the temple
On the top of the mountain

questions.text: What does Yahweh tell him to do with the vision?
questions.explanation: Habakkuk 2:2 says Yahweh answered him to write the vision and make it plain on tablets, so that he who runs may read it.

answers.text: Keep it sealed until the end
Tell it only to the priests

questions.text: What does verse 3 say about the vision's coming?
questions.explanation: Habakkuk 2:3 says that though it takes time, one should wait for it, because it will surely come and won't delay.

questions.text: How will the righteous live, according to verse 4?
questions.explanation: Habakkuk 2:4 says his soul is puffed up and not upright in him, but the righteous will live by his faith.

questions.text: The taunting proverb is spoken against the man who does what?
questions.explanation: Habakkuk 2:6 says woe to him who increases that which is not his and who enriches himself by extortion.

answers.text: Forgets the poor at his gate

questions.text: Why will the remnant of the peoples plunder him?
questions.explanation: Habakkuk 2:8 says that because he has plundered many nations, all the remnant of the peoples will plunder him.

answers.text: Because he broke his sworn oath
Because he burned the temple down
Because he scorned his own gods

questions.text: What will cry out of the wall?
questions.explanation: Habakkuk 2:11 says the stone will cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the woodwork will answer it.

questions.text: With what will the earth be filled, according to verse 14?
questions.explanation: Habakkuk 2:14 says the earth will be filled with the knowledge of Yahweh's glory, as the waters cover the sea.

questions.text: What is said of the idol overlaid with gold and silver?
questions.explanation: Habakkuk 2:19 says it is overlaid with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all within it.

answers.text: There is no breath within it
It will speak in its time
It was made by a prophet

questions.text: What does the last verse say the earth should do?
questions.explanation: Habakkuk 2:20 says Yahweh is in his holy temple, so let all the earth be silent before him.

answers.text: Lift up its voice in song
Bring its gifts to the city
